author: Josh Ayen
title: DeKalb ace Brockhouse commits to Dayton - NewsBreak
text:
By Josh Ayen No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
WATERLOO, Ind. (WANE) – After helping DeKalb baseball finish with their most successful season in nearly three decades, Miles Brockhouse is ready to lock in his college choice.
Following his junior season, DeKalb’s left-handed pitcher committed to the University of Dayton on Wednesday.
The southpaw went 9-1 on the bump with a 0.82 ERA in his junior season. Brockhouse struck out 110 batters, only allowing 18 runs on 36 hits and 22 walks over 68 innings of work. He was also solid at the plate, batting .368 with 16 RBI and three stolen bases.
Brockhouse helped DeKalb finish with a 21-5 record this past season. That included a sectional championship and the program’s first regional title since 1998 with a 2-1 win over Western.
